lines.zh: 我沿着教堂长廊走，圣水在腰边轻响。
lines.en: I walk the chapel aisle, holy water chiming at my belt.

lines.zh: 村路泥泞，我挨家挨户挂上大蒜。
lines.en: The path is mud; I hang garlic on every door.

lines.zh: 我提着油灯，绕开没有影子的巷口。
lines.en: Lantern in hand, I avoid alleys where nothing casts a shadow.

lines.zh: 袍角扫过石阶，我数着去钟楼的步数。
lines.en: My robe sweeps the steps as I count paces to the bell tower.

lines.zh: 我抱着圣水罐，走得很慢，怕洒了。
lines.en: I carry the holy water jar slowly, afraid to spill it.

lines.zh: 黄昏到了，我催孩子们赶紧回家。
lines.en: Dusk is here; I hurry the children inside their homes.

lines.zh: 我穿过墓地，嘴里念着安魂的句子。
lines.en: I cross the graveyard reciting the words for the dead.

lines.zh: 我去看发烧的铁匠，篮子里有面包。
lines.en: I visit the feverish blacksmith, bread in my basket.

lines.zh: 我踩着霜走，银十字在胸前发凉。
lines.en: I walk over frost, the silver cross cold on my chest.

lines.zh: 我沿墙根走，检查每扇窗是否关严。
lines.en: I follow the walls, checking that every shutter is shut.

lines.zh: 香炉的烟跟着我，绕过村中的水井。
lines.en: Censer smoke trails me around the village well.

lines.zh: 我走向教堂后门，那里藏着一箱圣水。
lines.en: I head for the back door, where a crate of holy water hides.

lines.zh: 有人敲门求救，我立刻披衣出门。
lines.en: Someone knocks for help; I throw on my robe and go.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，怕惊动屋顶上的蝙蝠。
lines.en: I tread softly, lest I wake the bats on the roof.

lines.zh: 我点起蜡烛，一根一根，直到天亮。
lines.en: I light candles one by one and keep them till dawn.

lines.zh: 圣书摊在桌上，我读到第三遍创世。
lines.en: The holy book lies open; I read Genesis a third time.

lines.zh: 我把大蒜编成串，挂在门框上。
lines.en: I braid garlic into ropes and hang them on the frames.

lines.zh: 我在数献祭箱里的铜币，今天很少。
lines.en: I count the coins in the offering box; few today.

lines.zh: 我搅动锅里的圣水，等它冒白气。
lines.en: I stir the holy water pot, waiting for white steam.

lines.zh: 我擦拭银十字，直到它照出我的脸。
lines.en: I polish the silver cross until it shows my face.

lines.zh: 我在写布道词，写到吸血鬼那一段停住。
lines.en: I write my sermon and stop at the part about vampires.

lines.zh: 我闻到地窖里有一点腐甜的味道。
lines.en: I smell something sweet and rotten from the cellar.

lines.zh: 我补袍子上的口子，针脚歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: I mend a tear in my robe with crooked stitches.

lines.zh: 我数着钟声，确认还不是午夜。
lines.en: I count the bell strikes to be sure it is not midnight.

lines.zh: 我把圣水小瓶摆正，一共十二瓶。
lines.en: I line up the holy water vials, twelve in all.

lines.zh: 我给祭坛换上新布，旧的已经发黄。
lines.en: I change the altar cloth; the old one has yellowed.

lines.zh: 我朝窗外看，太阳还剩一条边。
lines.en: I look out the window; the sun is a thin rim.

lines.zh: 我对着空教堂念完最后一句祷词。
lines.en: I finish the last prayer to an empty chapel.

lines.zh: 你的脖子上没有咬痕，很好。
lines.en: No bite marks on your neck. Good.

lines.zh: 你脸色太白了，让我看看你的眼睛。
lines.en: You look pale; let me see your eyes.

lines.zh: 夜里别出门，窗上要挂大蒜。
lines.en: Stay in at night, and hang garlic on your window.

lines.zh: 你身上有血味，是伤口还是别的？
lines.en: You smell of blood. A wound, or something else?

lines.zh: 进教堂吧，圣水就在门边的架子上。
lines.en: Come inside; the holy water sits by the door.

lines.zh: 我认得这枚护符，是猎人给的吧。
lines.en: I know that amulet. The hunters gave it to you.

lines.zh: 你来得正好，帮我抬一下圣水桶。
lines.en: Good timing; help me lift this holy water barrel.

lines.zh: 别在午夜后敲我的门，我不会开。
lines.en: Do not knock after midnight. I will not open.

lines.zh: 你的影子还在，我就放心一半了。
lines.en: Your shadow is still there, so I am half reassured.

lines.zh: 你要是被咬了，趁早告诉我。
lines.en: If you were bitten, tell me now, not later.

lines.zh: 礼拜还有一刻开始，坐前排吧。
lines.en: Service starts in a quarter hour; sit up front.

lines.zh: 你的十字架戴反了，银面朝外才对。
lines.en: Your cross is backwards; the silver faces outward.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里看见了疲倦，还有饥饿。
lines.en: I see weariness in your eyes, and hunger.

lines.zh: 别谢我，去把这份圣水送给她。
lines.en: Do not thank me; take this holy water to her.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，是怕我，还是怕夜？
lines.en: Your hands shake. Afraid of me, or of the night?

lines.zh: 先坐下吧，我把灯芯挑亮些。
lines.en: Sit down. Let me trim the wick brighter.

lines.zh: 你打碎了圣水瓶，那可是今天的量。
lines.en: You broke the holy water; that was today's ration.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨在响，但我还站得住。
lines.en: My ribs creak, but I am still standing.

lines.zh: 别打脸，我还要主持葬礼。
lines.en: Not the face; I still have a funeral to lead.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起十年前那场夜袭。
lines.en: This blow recalls the raid ten years ago.

lines.zh: 我流血了，快拿布来按住。
lines.en: I am bleeding; bring cloth and press it.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，祷词不能断。
lines.en: It hurts, but the prayer cannot stop.

lines.zh: 你打断了我念到一半的经文。
lines.en: You cut off the scripture I was halfway through.

lines.zh: 我的袍子破了，补起来很费线。
lines.en: My robe is torn, and mending costs much thread.

lines.zh: 我跪下去，又撑着祭坛站起来。
lines.en: I fall to my knees, then rise on the altar.

lines.zh: 银十字从我手里飞了出去。
lines.en: The silver cross flies out of my hand.

lines.zh: 面包刚出炉，我先掰一块给你。
lines.en: The bread is fresh; let me break you a piece.

lines.zh: 圣餐的酒很淡，但我还是想喝一口。
lines.en: The communion wine is weak, yet I still want a sip.

lines.zh: 蜂蜜糕的甜味让我忘了刚才的祷词。
lines.en: The honey cake's sweetness makes me forget my prayer.

lines.zh: 你把大蒜拿远点，那味道冲得慌。
lines.en: Move the garlic away; the smell is overwhelming.

lines.zh: 我闻到烤肉，肚子先替我回答了。
lines.en: I smell roast meat, and my stomach answers first.

lines.zh: 那篮苹果是给孤儿的，我只看一眼。
lines.en: Those apples are for orphans; I only look.

lines.zh: 蜡烛的蜡味混着面香，我走不动了。
lines.en: Wax and baking bread together root me in place.

lines.zh: 谁在煮汤？我这就去帮他们盛。
lines.en: Who is cooking soup? I will go and serve it.

lines.zh: 我发誓守斋，可这香味太坏了。
lines.en: I swore to fast, but this smell is wicked.

lines.zh: 一块就够，我不会多拿你的东西。
lines.en: One piece is enough; I will take no more.

lines.zh: 当心，你撞得我圣水差点洒了。
lines.en: Careful, you nearly spilled my holy water.

lines.zh: 我的袍子挂在你扣子上了，别动。
lines.en: My robe is caught on your buckle. Hold still.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我走路总低着头看脚下。
lines.en: Sorry, I always walk with my eyes on the ground.

lines.zh: 你撞过来时，我手里的十字掉了。
lines.en: When you bumped me, my cross fell.

lines.zh: 借过一下，我要赶在日落前回去。
lines.en: Let me pass; I must be back before sunset.

lines.zh: 别推，这罐圣水比我的骨头值钱。
lines.en: Do not push; this jar is worth more than my bones.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的袍角了，请抬一下脚。
lines.en: You are standing on my hem; lift your foot.

lines.zh: 我后退一步，给你让出路来。
lines.en: I step back to give you room to pass.

lines.zh: 撞得不重，只是我的灯灭了。
lines.en: It was not a hard knock; only my lamp went out.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两扇关不上的门。
lines.en: We collide like two doors that will not close.

lines.zh: 我发过誓不娶，这话我说了三十年。
lines.en: I took a vow against marriage thirty years ago.

lines.zh: 教堂里的婚礼我主持过很多场。
lines.en: I have performed many weddings in this chapel.

lines.zh: 你们要结婚，先让我看看手指。
lines.en: If you two would marry, let me see your hands.

lines.zh: 爱情是好事，只是别在夜里私奔。
lines.en: Love is good, but do not elope at night.

lines.zh: 我替新人念誓词，自己从不念。
lines.en: I read vows for couples, never for myself.

lines.zh: 我年轻时也心动过，后来进了教堂。
lines.en: I loved once, then I entered the chapel.

lines.zh: 戒指我收在圣器柜里，可以借你。
lines.en: The rings are in the reliquary; you may borrow one.

lines.zh: 你们的誓言要在天亮前说完。
lines.en: Say your vows before the sun comes up.

lines.zh: 别在我面前亲热，我只会念祝福。
lines.en: Do not court before me; all I know is blessing.

lines.zh: 婚姻是绳索，我替你们系紧它。
lines.en: Marriage is a rope; I tie it tight for you.

lines.zh: 地上那枚铜币，我捡起来放进箱里。
lines.en: I pick up the coin and put it in the box.

lines.zh: 谁掉的十字架？我先替它擦干净。
lines.en: Whose cross is this? I will wipe it clean.

lines.zh: 我拾起那截断掉的大蒜辫。
lines.en: I pick up the broken strand of garlic.

lines.zh: 这里有一瓶摔碎的圣水，可惜了。
lines.en: Here is a shattered vial of holy water, a waste.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的银戒指收进袖子里。
lines.en: I tuck the fallen silver ring into my sleeve.

lines.zh: 你掉了面包，我拍掉土再还你。
lines.en: You dropped bread; I brush off the dirt and return it.

lines.zh: 我捡到一张写满字的纸，看不懂。
lines.en: I find a written page I cannot read.

lines.zh: 地上有颗牙齿，不像人的。
lines.en: There is a tooth on the ground, and it is not human.

lines.zh: 我把散落的蜡烛一根根收好。
lines.en: I gather the scattered candles one by one.

lines.zh: 这封信我收着，等失主来问。
lines.en: I keep this letter until its owner asks.

lines.zh: 那道影子不对，我要拉响钟。
lines.en: That shadow is wrong; I will ring the bell.

lines.zh: 我看见它的牙齿了，是吸血鬼。
lines.en: I see the fangs. It is a vampire.

lines.zh: 我抓起十字架，手抖得厉害。
lines.en: I grab the cross; my hands are shaking.

lines.zh: 有东西翻墙进来了，叫醒猎人。
lines.en: Something climbed the wall; wake the hunters.

lines.zh: 它盯着羊圈，我先去堵门。
lines.en: It eyes the sheep pen; I will block the gate.

lines.zh: 我闻到血腥味，就在钟楼底下。
lines.en: I smell blood, right beneath the bell tower.

lines.zh: 屋顶的蝙蝠散了，它要来了。
lines.en: The bats on the roof scatter; it is coming.

lines.zh: 我认出那张脸，是上个月埋的人。
lines.en: I know that face; we buried him last month.

lines.zh: 别站在窗口，它会记住你的样子。
lines.en: Stay from the window; it will remember your face.

lines.zh: 我举起圣水，先泼过去再说。
lines.en: I raise the holy water and throw it first.

lines.zh: 我举着银十字，念它的名字。
lines.en: I hold up the silver cross and speak its name.

lines.zh: 退后三步，我要泼圣水了。
lines.en: Three steps back; I am splashing holy water.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的喉咙，那里没有心跳。
lines.en: I watch its throat; no heartbeat there.

lines.zh: 我的祷词一句接一句，不敢停。
lines.en: My prayers come one after another; I dare not stop.

lines.zh: 它在绕圈，我就跟着转。
lines.en: It circles, so I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我手里的瓶子只剩半瓶了。
lines.en: Only half a vial is left in my hand.

lines.zh: 别靠近，它在等我们露出破绽。
lines.en: Stay back; it waits for us to slip.

lines.zh: 我把大蒜撒成一圈，困住它。
lines.en: I scatter garlic in a ring to trap it.

lines.zh: 它笑了，我的膝盖在发抖。
lines.en: It smiles, and my knees are shaking.

lines.zh: 我念到第三段，十字开始发烫。
lines.en: By the third verse the cross grows hot.

lines.zh: 一整瓶圣水泼在它脸上，冒白烟。
lines.en: A whole vial of holy water hits its face and smokes.

lines.zh: 我用银十字砸它的额头。
lines.en: I strike its brow with the silver cross.

lines.zh: 大蒜塞进它嘴里，它吐了出来。
lines.en: I shove garlic in its mouth; it spits it out.

lines.zh: 我用圣水罐砸过去，罐子碎了。
lines.en: I hurl the jar; it shatters on impact.

lines.zh: 它扑过来，我把十字架顶上去。
lines.en: It lunges; I thrust the cross forward.

lines.zh: 我打了它一下，手被烫伤了。
lines.en: I land one blow, and my hand burns.

lines.zh: 我踩住它的袍角，让它慢半步。
lines.en: I pin its hem and slow it by half a step.

lines.zh: 香炉甩出去，火星溅了它一脸。
lines.en: I swing the censer; sparks spray across its face.

lines.zh: 我的拳头没用，但圣水有用。
lines.en: My fists are useless, but the holy water works.

lines.zh: 它退进阴影，我追着泼第二瓶。
lines.en: It retreats into shadow; I chase it with a second vial.

lines.zh: 教堂的门开了，我提着灯出来。
lines.en: The chapel door opens; I come out with a lamp.

lines.zh: 我在晨祷后站到村口，等第一缕光。
lines.en: After morning prayer I stand at the gate for first light.

lines.zh: 我从地窖上来，抱着一箱圣水。
lines.en: I climb from the cellar carrying a crate of holy water.

lines.zh: 钟敲六下，我推开礼拜堂的门。
lines.en: The bell strikes six; I push open the chapel doors.

lines.zh: 我在雪地里跺脚，暖一暖手指。
lines.en: I stamp my feet in the snow to warm my fingers.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙走来，袍子上还沾着灰。
lines.en: I come along the wall, ash still on my robe.

lines.zh: 昨夜有人死了，我一早就出门。
lines.en: Someone died last night; I leave at first light.

lines.zh: 我推开侧门，香炉的烟先飘出去。
lines.en: I open the side door and censer smoke drifts out first.

lines.zh: 我站在墓园门口，手里拿着名单。
lines.en: I stand at the graveyard gate with a list of names.

lines.zh: 我从钟楼下来，鞋底带着鸟粪。
lines.en: I come down from the bell tower, bird droppings on my soles.

lines.zh: 火舌舔到我的袍角，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Flame licks my hem, and I slap it twice.

lines.zh: 我从钟楼的梯子上滑了下来。
lines.en: I slipped down the bell tower ladder.

lines.zh: 圣水桶翻了，我呛了一大口。
lines.en: The barrel tipped, and I swallowed a mouthful.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻了长椅，我被压在下面。
lines.en: The blast flipped a pew onto me.

lines.zh: 一支弩箭射穿了我的袖子。
lines.en: A crossbow bolt went through my sleeve.

lines.zh: 有股邪术钻进我的骨头，很冷。
lines.en: Some hex crawls into my bones, cold and wrong.

lines.zh: 守斋太久了，我眼前发黑。
lines.en: I have fasted too long; my sight darkens.

lines.zh: 雷打中了钟楼，我被震得耳鸣。
lines.en: Lightning struck the bell tower and left my ears ringing.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地了，我掉进黑暗。
lines.en: The ground is gone; I fall into the dark.
